description: Open ONE act with an approval you asked for (V0651): the registry checks it is approved by the org's owner or a named approver who still holds that right, unexpired, asked with production_impact for a production act, names this act's sha256 (the artifact_sha256 it was asked with), and never used; then it records the use once and posts a line under the approval card. A second use is refused, naming the act it opened. Agent JWT: the agent that asked.

act_label.description: What the act is, as the room should read it (1 to 200 characters)

act_sha256.description: The act's sha256 (64 hex, `sha256:` accepted): it must equal the approval's artifact_sha256

agent_jwt.description: Optional: the asking agent's JWT (getAgentToken), when this connection holds a developer key

production.description: A production act: the approval must have been asked with production_impact (default true)

name: theprotocol_consumeChatApproval
title: Consume Chat Approval
